meta.title: A complete single-stage RFQ publishes and lands on the project
gaps: Execute the create, configure, schedule, invite, Publish and confirm flow: the prepared event is already published and those state-changing steps are unavailable.
Verify that Publish caused the redirect rather than opening an already-published project directly.
Explicitly assert the URL excludes quick-create, create, detail and new; the catalog provides no negative URL assertion.
Assert the event's Live status and exact invited-vendor count on the project screen using confirmed controls.
Check for no error toast specifically within one second after Publish.
Verify or enable the rfx_project_enabled tenant gate.
